body:
On Strategy > Tasks, replace the Milestone column's selector with a read-only link to the milestone record. For a task with a milestone, render the loaded milestone title as an `<a href="/milestone/{id}">`; when the milestone is not loaded, link its id instead. A task with no milestone shows `—`. Keep the Feature column's selector, Milestone sorting, row opening and paging unchanged.

This is the milestone-only part of canceled task:97659639c8ac4bbf; the Feature column stays editable.

**Tests:** a loaded title and its href; an unloaded id and its href; no milestone as `—`; no select in the Milestone cell; Feature and Milestone sorting, paging and row opening stay green. **Docs:** update the Tasks tab's inline-links section in the Strategy README to say only Feature remains an inline selector and Milestone is a read-only link.
title: tasks: milestone link read-only
